virtual_capital.note: Mirrors the real Robinhood Tier 0 test. All sizing, limits and returns use this virtual account, never the ~$100k paper balance.

loss_limits.note: Disabled at Tier 0, mirroring the owner's choice for the Robinhood test (2026-10-16). Computed and reported, not enforced.

owner_notes: Alpaca paper twin of ../trading-bot (2026-10-20). Paper account configured with max_margin_multiplier 1 and no_shorting true; Alpaca's paper minimum options level is 3, so options are blocked by .claude/settings.json and scripts/order-guard.py. To read the first-run report before any order, set operating_mode to discovery.
